deterministic_data.verification: PostgreSQL v3 is closed for 25 tables and 80 deterministic PostgresCabinetUnitOfWork methods; the operation-scoped UoW factory, protected filesystem byte store, recoverable source-publication journal, transfer/Registry/recovery evidence, and sole bootstrap composition root are all assembled. Final Workbench assembly is 8/8 ready with zero errors.

modules.summary: Deterministic model surface, including the persistence runtime records and bounded principal-kind UoW query, is structurally and identity-closed.
Closed capability catalogue and exact-name resolution leave only deterministic internal representation variation; construction cannot read a clock or retain clock-derived state.

Self-identifying bearer verification, exact grants, principal resolution, throttle, and audit persistence are lowered through named operation-scoped UoW calls; lifecycle timestamps are timezone-aware UTC and elapsed throttle intervals use monotonic time.
Effect reservation, commit, and reconciliation use the shared operation-scoped UoW with deterministic PostgreSQL locking and replay evidence.

Immutable Card revisions, canonical preparation, caller-owned transaction commits, current-head selection, identity locking, and expected-revision storage mechanics are closed; Card policy remains in the workspace.

Revision-exact Invoice reads: one rolled-back UoW per read, canonical revision parsing through parse_invoice_revision/load_invoice_revisions, working-set indexing, ordered search and duplicate matching under the declared rules; no mutation path.

Declared-order evaluation of rules.invoice_workspace.validation_checks through evaluate_validation_checks, proposal parsing and provenance checks, duplicate reuse through the retained catalogue; performs no write.

Invoice lifecycle state machine: shared authorization through require_mutation_authorization, exact-revision loads through load_expected_draft, single-commit successors through commit_invoice_successor, and atomic manifest/working-set derivation through derive_transfer_records; consumers card_workspace, catalogue and validator.
Project Card, estimate, shopping-list, and linkage mutations run through the shared Card/UoW transaction boundary without separate storage authority.

PostgreSQL v3 lowering is closed for all accepted server durable projections with 25 tables and 81 deterministic repository methods; composition-owned UoW factory construction remains outside the emitter target.
Factory-owned filesystem backend closes confinement, staging, verification, content addressing, atomic publication, and staging compensation mechanics.
Verifier-only handoff storage, custody rows, recoverable publication journal, protected byte-store port, and release evidence are closed across the DB/file boundary.
Working sets, manifests, node-scoped issuance, exact receipts, conflicts, assignment evidence, and reconciliation reads have durable UoW storage.
Catalogue snapshot/replica, publication idempotency, and current-selector storage are explicit and atomic under the shared UoW.
All application-service dependencies and exact operation contracts are lowered; proposal/effect orchestration permits only internal variation.
Access-control and source-custody dependencies are explicit; the gateway retains only transport/security-boundary variation.
Access, exchange, and Registry dependencies carry their closed operation contracts; unknown synchronization dispatch remains forbidden.
Readiness and restore verification now depend on the closed UoW factory, byte store, durable drill evidence, and startup recovery mechanisms.
Deterministic Router IR and handler lowering remain closed against the updated assembled specification.

The sole composition root is explicit: protected configuration, migrations, recovery, UoW factory, byte store, service graph, and create_app handoff are fixed; only internal construction details may vary.
